import re,os
frags=[b'8XDP5Q2RT9Z',b'K7VB3BV4WW54']
cands=set()
full=(frags[0]+frags[1])
full2=(frags[1]+frags[0])
for base in (full,full2):
    # trim/pad to 23 keeping start 8XD & end W54
    bs=base
    # ensure starts 8XD
    if bs.startswith(b'8XD'): pass
    else: continue
    for drop in range(0,len(bs)-22):
        for start in range(0,drop+1):
            s=bs[start:start+23]
            if len(s)==23 and s.startswith(b'8XD') and s.endswith(b'W54') and re.fullmatch(rb'[A-Z0-9]{23}',s):
                cands.add(s)
print('cands',cands)
os.makedirs('/app',exist_ok=True)
with open('/app/recovered_passwords.txt','w') as fh:
    for c in sorted(cands): fh.write(c.decode()+'\n')
print(open('/app/recovered_passwords.txt').read())
EOF
